disclaimer.title: Important Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: DICOMassist is an educational and research tool.
disclaimer.item1: This software is NOT certified as a medical device
disclaimer.item2: It is NOT intended for clinical diagnosis, treatment planning, or any clinical decision-making
disclaimer.item3: AI-generated analysis may contain errors, hallucinations, or inaccurate findings
disclaimer.item4: Never use this tool as a substitute for professional medical judgment
disclaimer.item5: All DICOM files are processed locally in your browser — no medical data is uploaded to our servers
disclaimer.item6: When using AI analysis, image data is sent to the selected LLM provider (e.g., Anthropic Claude API) according to their data handling policies
disclaimer.acknowledge: By continuing, you acknowledge that this tool is for educational purposes only and accept full responsibility for any use of the information provided.
